name: Face Razor
subtitle: Pain free and precise facial hair removal
usageInstructions: Wash your face and pat dry. Apply a moisturizing lotion or facial gel of your choice. Take out the razor's protective cover. Pull the skin tightly, slide the razor gently downwards at an angle of 45 degrees. Once done, clean the blade with a damp cloth and put the cover back on. Follow up with a Moisturiser.
description: Painless and convenient hair removal: Bodywise Face Razor allows for effortless and quick hair removal without any form of discomfort or pain. Zero pain and cuts: The zig zag pattern on the blade ensures that there are no cuts and the anti-slip handle ensures that you avoid any accidental moves. Precise removal: The curve and the anti-slip grip in the razor's design helps in giving a precise shave. Perfect for shaping eyebrows and removing sideburns, upper lip and chin hair. Hygienic and safe: Each blade is made with stainless steel which doesn't allow it to rust. It also comes with a protective cover, which prevents it from getting dirty. Improves the appearance of skin: With each shave - you also remove debris, excess oil and dead skin cells which leads to a smoother and brighter appearance. It also improves the absorption of skincare products giving you better results and a smoother makeup application.

Stop using the product if you experience irritation. Don't use the razor over acne, breakouts or inflamed skin. Do not exceed more than 8-10 uses. list.title: Is face razor good for face for women?
list.content: Shaving your face is beneficial. Regular use leads to smoother and soft skin. It also mildly exfoliates giving your skincare products a better chance to work

list.title: Does face razor increase hair growth?
list.content: No hair removal method causes thicker or darker growth, including shaving. Hair growth depends on your follicle health. Shaving gives you a blunt tip, i.e. when it grows back, it has a sharper tip but it doesn't change hair growth

list.title: Will shaving upper lip make it darker?
list.content: Shaving does not make the skin darker. It is just a hair removal method. Unlike some depilatory creams that  can darken the appearance of skin over time - shaving simply does not cause dark skin

list.title: Is razor good for facial hair removal?
list.content: Your facial skin is very delicate compared to your body. Threading or waxing might give you hair-free skin for a longer period but the pulling and tension can be harmful. Particularly for sensitive skin- other methods often cause itching and discomfort were as shaving does not.

list.title: How often should a woman shave her face?
list.content: Women should shave their faces according to their growth. Some women have a lesser growth, making it okay to shave once in two weeks, while others need to shave once a week.

list.title: Should I wax or shave my face?
list.content: Short answer - it's up to you. Both methods have merits and demerits of their own but if you are looking for a painless and easy method for hair removal that also benefits your skin- shaving is the answer!

list.title: What to apply after shaving face?
list.content: Post shaving, your face would feel soft due to the exfoliation of dead skin cells. You should follow up with a thick moisturiser filled with antioxidants like (Vitamin E or Hyaluronic Acid). If you are someone with oily skin, you can also try Be Bodywise Oil Control Moisturiser.

list.title: Can I shave my female upper lip?
list.content: Yes - you can shave your upper lip without the fear of darkening and thick hair

list.title: Can I shave my face every day?
list.content: No, you probably won't need to and it's not recommended to shave face everyday. If you are looking ahead to achieve that complete hairless look, it is suggested that you wait for a day or two between the shaving.

list.title: Can we apply face pack after shaving face?
list.content: We suggest moisturising your skin first and waiting a few hours before applying a face mask.

list.title: What should you not do after shaving your face?
list.content: Here are the don'ts after shaving your face. </br>Do not forget to moisturise and protect your skin: As you shave, your skin sheds dead skin cells, which leave your skin vulnerable. Thus, protect your skin by adding a layer of moisturiser and sunscreen. </br>Avoid applying makeup directly: Don't apply makeup or alcohol-based products on freshly shaved skin.

list.title: Can I use a clay mask after shaving my face?
list.content: We suggest moisturising your skin first and waiting a few hours before applying a clay mask.

list.title: Can I put coconut oil on my face after shaving?
list.content: Coconut oil has good emollient qualities making it an apt moisturiser post-shaving. However, you are someone with oily or acne-prone skin, the comedogenic properties of coconut oil might not be suitable for your skin. We'd suggest using Be Bodywise Oil Control Moisturiser.
